title: Austin Staffing Shake-Up & New Mechanic Role
summary:
*   **Mass Resignations in Fire Department**: Four firefighters—Jack Mussett, A. J. Hamilton, S. J. Bryant, and Davis Cottle—resigned from the Austin Fire Department.
*   **New Firefighters Appointed**: The city immediately confirmed four new firefighters—Beno Wiesian, L. T. Barho, Fillmore Peterson, and W. P. Matlock—to fill the sudden vacancies.
*   **Specialized Mechanic Hired**: The city authorized the hiring of Harry Smith as a truck driver and expert mechanic, addressing a specific operational need.

REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
Austin, Texas, September 16, 1920.
The Council was called to order by the Mayor Pro Tem, H. L. Haynes.
Roll call showed the following members present: Mayor Pro Tem Haynes, Councilmen Alford,
Graham and Ward, 4; absent, Mayor Yett.
The Communication of Howard Walker was read and upon motion of Councilman Alford was
referred to Councilman Ward by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Pro Tem Haynes, Councilmen
Alford, Graham and Ward, 4; absent, Mayor Yett.
Resignation of Jack Mussett The resignation of Jack Mussett as fireman in the Fire
Department Resignation of A. J. Hamilton was accepted by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor
Pro Tem Haynes, CouncilS. J. Bryant Resignation men Alford, Graham and Ward, 4 ; nayes,
none.
Resignation of Davis Cottle The resignation of A. J. Hamilton as fireman in the Fire
Department was accepted by the following vote: Mayor Pro Tem Haynes, Councilmen Alford,
Graham and Ward, 4; nayes, none.
The resignation of S. J. Bryant as fireman in the Fire Department was accepted by the
following vote: Ayes, Mayor Pro Tem Haynes, Councilmen Alford, Graham and Ward, 4; nayes,
none.
The resignation of Davis Cottle as fireman in the Fire Department was accepted by the
following vote: Ayes, Mayor Pro Tem Haynes, Councilmen Alford, Graham and Ward, 4; nayes,
none.
Councilman Alford nominated Beno Wiesian as fireman to succeed Jack Mussett, resigned.
Nomination was confirmed by the following vote: Ayes, appo'd Mayor Pro Tem Haynes,
Councilmen Graham and Ward, nayes, none, Council- appo'd man Alford not voting. appo'd
Councilman Alford nominated L. T. Barho to succeed A. J. Hamilton , appo'd resigned, as
fireman. Nomination was confirmed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Pro Tem Haynes,
Councilmen Graham and Ward, nayes, none, Councilman Alford not voting.
Councilman Alford nominated Fillmore Peterson as fireman to succeed S. J. Bryant,
resigned. Nomination was confirmed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Pro Tem Haynes,
Councilmen Graham and Ward, nayes, none, Councilman Alford not voting.
Councilman Alford nominated W. P. Matlock as fireman to succeed Davis Cottle, resigned.
Nomination was confirmed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Pro Tem Haynes, Councilmen
Graham and Ward, nayes, none, Councilman Alford present but not voting.
Councilman Graham moved that he be authorized to employ Harry Smith as truck driver and
expert mechanic. Motion carried by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Pro Tem Haynes,
Councilmen Alford, Graham and Ward, nayes, none.
The Council then adjourned.
J. W. Chy
City Clerk
